Run.Esm.Hint: Node 把 Windows 盘符当成了 URL 协议。ESM 加载器只认 file:// —— 这来自某个 --import / --loader 参数传的是文件路径，常见来源是环境变量 NODE_OPTIONS 里别的 Node 工具留下的 --import。启动器会在启动前自动改写；仍报这个错就清掉它再启动。

Node treated a Windows drive letter as a URL scheme. The ESM loader only accepts file:// — this comes from an --import / --loader argument given a file path, most often an --import left in NODE_OPTIONS by another Node tool. The launcher rewrites it before starting; if the error persists, clear that variable and start again.

Run.Esm.Title: 酒馆没能启动：Node 的模块路径格式不对
The tavern could not start: wrong module path format in Node
Run.Esm.Body: ESM 加载器把 Windows 路径当成了 URL。检查系统环境变量 NODE_OPTIONS 里的 --import / --loader，路径必须是 file:// URL；清掉它再启动即可。
The ESM loader treated a Windows path as a URL. Check --import / --loader in the NODE_OPTIONS environment variable — paths must be file:// URLs. Clear it and start again.
